# Parity Accessibility Contract

Brownfield visual parity must include explicit interaction, failure-state, responsive, and assistive-technology behavior rather than screenshot similarity alone.

## What Happened

In SALUS Pramana task t7, the active and archived experiences included invisible contracts such as
persona-invariant evidence, retained form context after errors, fail-closed editor controls,
sanitized auth callbacks, focus return, and non-visual chart/map equivalents.

## Takeaway

For each preserved route, specify the full state set, focus and announcement behavior, compact/wide
transformation, and non-visual equivalent. Keep every source requirement ID explicit in the coverage
matrix; grouped ranges can conceal missing traceability.
